watches.name: Lululemon gym M-L
watches.notes: Prioritise Pace Breaker, License to Train, Metal Vent Tech and other technical training lines. Generic casual pieces are weaker.

watches.name: Ten Thousand gym M-L
watches.notes: Interval, Session, Tactical and other genuine Ten Thousand training pieces.

watches.name: Vuori gym M-L
watches.notes: Technical tees, shorts and pants. Prefer Kore, Strato, Sunday Performance.

watches.name: Craft ADV M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical gym or running clothing
watches.notes: ADV and PRO lines strongly preferred. Cheap basic Craft pieces are not enough on their own.

watches.name: Odlo technical M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical gym, running or base-layer clothing
watches.notes: Performance, Zeroweight, Blackcomb and premium technical lines preferred.

watches.name: GOREWEAR M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical training or running clothing
watches.notes: Prioritise genuinely technical pieces over basic logo tees.

watches.name: 2XU M-L
watches.notes: Compression tights, shorts and technical tops. Excellent condition required.

watches.name: New Balance 990 size 43
watches.notes: Prefer Made in USA 990v4, v5 or v6. Condition and sole wear matter heavily. Reject suspicious fakes.

watches.name: New Balance 991 size 43
watches.notes: Made in UK models preferred. Strong authenticity check required.

watches.name: New Balance 993 size 43
watches.notes: Made in USA. Reject heavily worn heel, outsole or lining.

watches.name: ASICS Gel Kayano 14 size 43
watches.notes: Authenticity is important because this model is frequently replicated.

watches.name: ASICS GT-2160 size 43
watches.notes: Good condition and meaningful discount required.

watches.name: John Smedley M-L
watches.notes: Fine-gauge merino preferred. Inspect for moth holes, shrinkage, stains and stretched cuffs.

watches.name: William Lockie M-L
watches.notes: Cashmere, Geelong and lambswool. Material and condition matter more than low price.

watches.name: Gran Sasso M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium knitwear or knit polo
watches.notes: Merino and high-quality Italian knitwear preferred.

watches.name: Fedeli M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium knitwear, polo or T-shirt
watches.notes: Merino, cashmere and premium cotton. Strong condition required.

watches.name: Sunspel M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium T-shirt, polo or knitwear
watches.notes: Classic premium T-shirts, polos and merino pieces. Avoid underwear unless unusually compelling.

watches.name: Icebreaker merino M-L
watches.target_type: men's merino T-shirt, long sleeve or technical layer
watches.notes: High merino content preferred. Check holes and excessive pilling.

watches.name: Devold merino M-L
watches.target_type: men's merino T-shirt, long sleeve or technical layer
watches.notes: Prioritise genuine high-merino technical pieces.

watches.name: Cashmere wildcard M-L
watches.notes: Only genuinely high-quality cashmere from a credible maker. Reject anonymous low-grade cashmere, blends presented as pure cashmere, moth damage or shrinkage.

watches.name: Seraphine maternity L-XL
watches.notes: High-priority brand. Prioritise maternity dresses, workwear, coats, knitwear, trousers and premium nursing-compatible maternity pieces. Strong preference for pieces originally expensive enough to justify shipping.

watches.name: Isabella Oliver maternity L-XL
watches.notes: High-priority premium maternity brand. Dresses, knitwear, tops and tailored maternity pieces are especially interesting. Reject ordinary non-maternity Isabella Oliver pieces unless explicitly suitable for pregnancy.

watches.name: Pietro Brunelli maternity L-XL
watches.notes: Premium Italian maternity brand. Prioritise dresses, trousers, coats and smart maternity clothing. Excellent condition required.

watches.name: Tiffany Rose maternity dress L-XL
watches.notes: Only maternity occasion dresses. Original retail can be high, so substantial absolute savings matter. Condition must be excellent, with no stains, pulls or damaged lace.

watches.name: Boob Design maternity L-XL
watches.target_type: women's premium maternity and nursing clothing
watches.notes: High priority when the piece works during pregnancy and later for nursing. Merino, wool, dresses, sweatshirts and technical maternity/nursing garments are particularly valuable.

watches.name: Ripe Maternity L-XL
watches.notes: Prioritise versatile maternity dresses, trousers, knitwear and pieces that also work postpartum or for nursing. Avoid low-value basic tees unless bundled.

watches.name: Noppies maternity L-XL
watches.notes: Good quality everyday maternity brand. Dresses, trousers, jeans, knitwear and jackets preferred. Basic low-cost tops should only score highly if bundled or unusually good.

watches.name: Mamalicious maternity L-XL
watches.notes: The buyer already likes Mamalicious. Prioritise dresses, trousers, leggings, knitwear, blouses, jumpsuits and outerwear. A cheap basic T-shirt alone is not an outstanding deal because shipping and Vinted fees make low-value purchases unattractive. Prefer excellent condition, bundles, or substantial pieces.

watches.name: Envie de Fraise maternity L-XL
watches.notes: Prioritise dresses, trousers, blouses and maternity-specific pieces. Avoid generic low-value tops unless part of a bundle.

watches.name: JoJo Maman Bebe maternity L-XL
watches.notes: Good practical maternity wear. Prioritise dresses, jeans, trousers, knitwear, dungarees and outerwear. Low-value basics should not trigger alerts individually.
